definition_zh: 使黯然失色；使相形见绌；给……蒙上阴影；遮蔽
definition_en: to make someone or something seem less important by being much more impressive, or to cast a dark shadow over something
core_image: 一棵大树把整片草地罩在自己的影子里
scene: 颁奖礼上，两位新人同台领奖，观众的视线却全被其中一位吸走。At the awards ceremony, the newcomer overshadowed the veteran actor.
sceneCN: 这里 overshadow 是「使黯然失色」，属于第 1 个义项（比他人在光芒上压倒对方）；句意：颁奖礼上，这位新人的风头盖过了那位老戏骨。

pos.zh: 使黯然失色；使相形见绌
给……蒙上阴影；使（事物）不能顺利发展
遮蔽；投下阴影于（字面义，较书面）

collocations.zh: 给发展蒙上阴影，使发展受阻
被……的光芒盖过；因……而显得失色

derivatives.zh: 由动词加 -ing 构成的名词，指「遮蔽；盖过」的过程
由过去分词转化的形容词，表示「被盖过的；笼罩在阴影下的」
现在分词作定语，表示「投下阴影的；让人不安的」

senses.title: To be more impressive than someone else
senses.titleCN: 使黯然失色；使相形见绌
senses.definition: to be so impressive that someone else gets less attention or praise
senses.definitionCN: 本身太出众，以致别人的关注或赞誉被比下去
senses.example: The young violinist overshadowed every other performer at the concert.
senses.exampleCN: 这位年轻小提琴手让音乐会上其他表演者都黯然失色。
senses.why: Over- means covering or above, so one light can spread over and dim another; this is the dominant modern sense.
senses.whyCN: over- 表示「覆盖、在上方」，一束光盖住另一束就会把对方压暗，由此长出现代最常用的「被比下去」义。

senses.title: To cast a dark shadow over an event
senses.definition: to make an event or situation feel less happy or less able to proceed well
senses.definitionCN: 使某个事件或局面变得不那么愉快，或难以顺利发展
senses.example: The sudden death of a team member overshadowed the whole tournament.
senses.exampleCN: 一名队员的意外去世给整届赛事蒙上了阴影。
senses.why: From dimming a light, the word turns to dimming a mood: a shadow lies over the whole event.
senses.whyCN: 从「压暗光亮」转向「压暗心情」，阴影盖住整件事，于是表示不祥与气氛低落。

senses.title: To throw a shadow over something
senses.definition: to cast a shadow over a place or thing, so that it is less bright
senses.definitionCN: 在某个地方或物体上投下阴影，使其变暗
senses.example: A tall oak overshadowed the garden bench in the afternoon.
senses.exampleCN: 午后，一棵高大的橡树把花园长凳遮在阴影里。
senses.why: This is the literal picture built into the word: over plus shadow, a shadow placed over something.
senses.whyCN: 这是词形里最直白的画面：over（在上方）加 shadow（影子），把影子罩在某物之上。

senses.title: To prevent something from developing
senses.titleCN: 使受压抑；使不能顺利发展
senses.definition: to limit the growth, success, or improvement of a person, idea, or plan
senses.definitionCN: 限制某人、某个想法或计划的成长、成功或改进
senses.example: Constant criticism can overshadow the confidence of a young child.
senses.exampleCN: 不断的批评会给孩子的自信蒙上阴影，压制其成长。
senses.why: A plant kept in shadow grows weakly; from that image the word comes to mean holding back progress.
senses.whyCN: 长在阴影里的植物总是长不好，借这个画面，词义延伸到「压住发展」。

intro.en: Overshadow is a native English compound of over and shadow, built from Old English ofer and sceadu.
intro.cn: overshadow 是英语本土复合词，由 over 与 shadow 两部分组成，前者源自古英语 ofer，后者源自古英语 sceadu。

items.en: Ofer means over or above, and sceadu means shade or shadow.
items.cn: ofer 表示「在上方、覆盖」，sceadu 表示「阴凉、影子」。

items.en: Sceadwis, formed with -wis, already meant shadowy or gloomy.
items.cn: 由 sceadu 加词尾 -wis 构成的 sceadwis 已表示「有影子的、阴沉的」。

items.en: The noun schadow settles into its modern spelling shadow.
items.cn: 中古英语名词 schadow 逐渐定型为今天的 shadow。

items.en: Attested compounds such as overshadow appear, and the words are sometimes written with hyphens or as two separate words.
items.cn: 像 overshadow 这样的复合形式已有记录，当时常写作带连字符或分写的形式。

items.en: The figurative sense of outshining or spoiling grows strong in modern usage.
items.cn: 现代用法中，「盖过他人」与「使气氛受损」的比喻义大为兴盛。

note.en: Overshadow shares its shadow element with shadow, shade, and other over compounds, and it sits near words about being outdone.
note.cn: overshadow 与 shadow、shade 共享「影子」这一成分，也与其它 over 开头的复合词相邻，意义靠近「被比下去」一类词。

entries.definition: a dark shape made when something blocks light
entries.definitionCN: 影子；阴影（与 overshadow 共享影子这一成分）

entries.definition: slight darkness where light is blocked
entries.definitionCN: 阴凉处；遮光的部分

entries.definition: to fail to notice something
entries.definitionCN: 忽略；没有注意到（虽有 over 前缀，与 overshadow 义不同）

entries.definition: to take out more money than an account holds
entries.definitionCN: 透支（与 overshadow 同为 over 加动词的复合形式）

entries.definition: to do or be much better than another so that they lose attention
entries.definitionCN: 使失色；盖过（比 overshadow 更书面，强调光芒被吞没）

entries.definition: to be much better than someone else
entries.definitionCN: 胜过；比……出色得多

entries.definition: to do better than someone else
entries.definitionCN: 超过；做得比……好

normalIntro.en: Overshadow puts a shadow over: over plus shadow, so light is covered and the mood is dimmed.
normalIntro.cn: overshadow 就是把影子罩上去：over 加 shadow，既盖住光亮，也压低气氛。

normal.en: The verb is a compound of over and shadow, so its picture is a shadow laid over something.
normal.cn: 这个动词是 over 与 shadow 的复合，画面就是把影子盖在某物之上。

normal.en: Be overshadowed by means someone else is getting all the attention.
normal.cn: be overshadowed by 表示注意力全被另一个人吸走。

normal.en: Overshadow the development is a warning that a new problem will hold progress back.
normal.cn: overshadow the development 是警告某个新问题会拖住发展。

normal.en: Compare eclipse: eclipse is more literary, overshadow is the everyday choice.
normal.cn: 对比 eclipse：eclipse 更书面，overshadow 更日常。

normal.en: Like outperform, overshadow describes one side beating another, but it goes through light and shadow.
normal.cn: 和 outperform 一样表示一方胜过一方，但 overshadow 是借光与影来说的。

abstract.en: Picture one spotlight so bright that the second stage light looks dark.
abstract.cn: 想象一束追光太亮，旁边那盏舞台灯就显得暗淡。

abstract.en: Imagine a cloud sliding over the whole stadium just as the match should start.
abstract.cn: 想象比赛正要开始时，一片云缓缓滑到整个体育场上空。

abstract.en: Think of a sprouting seedling left in the shade of a wall.
abstract.cn: 想象一棵刚发芽的小苗，被一堵墙的影子盖住。

examples.en: Her early success completely overshadowed the achievements of her brothers.
examples.cn: 她早早取得的成功，让哥哥们的成就相形见绌。

examples.en: The accident overshadowed the opening ceremony.
examples.cn: 这场事故给开幕式蒙上了阴影。

examples.en: Tall apartment blocks overshadow the narrow street below.
examples.cn: 高楼大厦把下面的窄街遮在阴影里。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「欧沃-晒豆」——把影子像豆子一样一层层铺盖到对面去，遮住了别人的光；这只是谐音联想，与词源无关。

root: over（在上方、覆盖，源自古英语 ofer）+ shadow（影子，源自古英语 sceadu）→ 把影子盖在某物之上，引申为「盖过他人的光」「压低气氛」。

sensesIntro.en: The word starts with the literal picture of a shadow laid over something, then grows into dimming a mood, outshining a person, and holding back growth.
sensesIntro.cn: overshadow 从「把影子盖上去」这一字面画面出发，再长出「压低气氛」「盖过他人」「压抑发展」三层意思。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a shadow laid over whatever lies beneath.
core.cn: 核心意象：影子盖在下面的东西上。

branches.en: A person whose light is covered becomes the less noticed one.
branches.cn: 光被别人盖住的人，就成了不太被注意的一方。

branches.en: A shadow over an event means its joy is covered.
branches.cn: 阴影盖住一场事件，就是它的喜悦被压住了。

branches.en: The literal sense keeps the original picture of over plus shadow.
branches.cn: 字面义完整保留了 over 加 shadow 的原始画面。

branches.en: Both gloom and stunted growth come from being shaded.
branches.cn: 阴沉气氛与成长受阻，都来自「被遮住」这一根源。

branches.en: A strong rival can outshine you and also crowd out your chances.
branches.cn: 强大的对手既可能盖过你的光芒，也可能挤掉你的机会。

intro.en: Overshadow is built from the prefix over and the noun shadow, with simple verb endings added.
intro.cn: overshadow 由前缀 over 与名词 shadow 构成，再配上动词的各种屈折词尾。

latinIntro.en: Neither half is Latin; over comes from Old English ofer and shadow from Old English sceadu, though sceadu is related to Latin umbra.
latinIntro.cn: 两部分都不是拉丁语：over 源自古英语 ofer，shadow 源自古英语 sceadu，不过 sceadu 与拉丁语 umbra（影子）有远亲关系。

items.example: The prefix over- gives the sense of covering.
items.exampleCN: 前缀 over- 带来「覆盖」的意思。

items.meaning: a dark shape made by blocked light
items.example: Shadow supplies the picture of dimmed light.
items.exampleCN: shadow 提供光线被压暗的画面。

items.example: Overshadow joins the two parts into a full verb.
items.exampleCN: overshadow 把两部分合成一个完整动词。

items.example: The suffix -s forms overshadows.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -s 构成 overshadows。

items.meaning: past tense and past participle ending
items.meaningCN: 过去式与过去分词词尾
items.example: The suffix -ed forms overshadowed.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -ed 构成 overshadowed。

items.example: The suffix -ing forms overshadowing.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -ing 构成 overshadowing。

items.example: Shade is the shorter cousin of shadow.
items.exampleCN: shade 是 shadow 更短的近亲。

items.meaning: kept in the shadow of another
items.meaningCN: 被盖过的；笼罩在阴影下的
items.example: Overshadowed describes a person who is outshone.
items.exampleCN: overshadowed 形容被人比下去的人。

items.meaningCN: 有阴凉的；也可引申为可疑的
items.example: Shady grows from the same shade noun.
items.exampleCN: shady 由同一个 shade 名词长成。

latinEntries.meaningCN: 影子；阴凉（与古英语 sceadu 同出一系，是远亲而非直接来源）

definition_zh: 超速；以超过限制的速度行驶；使超速；（机器）超速运转
definition_en: to drive or run faster than the permitted or safe speed, or to make an engine or machine run beyond its normal speed
core_image: 一辆车冲过限速牌，仪表指针甩到了红线之外
scene: 隧道出口的限速牌还竖在那里，一辆货车却半点没减速。The truck continued to overspeed long after the warning sign.
sceneCN: 这里 overspeed 作动词，是「超速行驶」，属于第 1 个义项（车速超过规定）；句意：过了警示牌很久，那辆货车仍在超速行驶。

pos.zh: 超速行驶；开快车
使超速；使（发动机等）超速运转
超速（行驶）
超速的（用于修饰档位、装置等）

derivatives.zh: 由动词加 -ing 构成的名词，指「超速驾驶」这一行为
动词加 -er 构成的施事名词，指「超速驾驶者」（口语多用 speeding driver）
由过去分词转化的形容词，表示「超速过的」（旧式写法，现多用 oversped）

senses.title: To drive faster than the allowed limit
senses.definition: to drive a vehicle faster than the speed limit
senses.definitionCN: 驾驶车辆时超过规定的速度限制
senses.example: Police fined him for overspeeding on the motorway.
senses.exampleCN: 他因在高速公路上超速驾驶被罚款。
senses.why: Over- means beyond a limit and speed supplies the measured value, so the verb is simply to go past the allowed speed.
senses.whyCN: over- 表示「超过限度」，speed 是那个被测量的量，所以动词的本义就是「越过允许的速度」。

senses.title: To make an engine run too fast
senses.definition: to make an engine or machine run beyond the speed it was designed for
senses.definitionCN: 使发动机或机器以超过设计速度运转
senses.example: Never overspeed the motor when the load is removed.
senses.exampleCN: 卸下负载时，绝不要让电动机超速运转。
senses.why: The same prefix moves from a driver to a machine: a machine that passes its safe speed is also over speeding.
senses.whyCN: 同一个前缀从人转到机器上：机器越过安全转速，也是「超速」。

senses.title: An act of going beyond the speed limit
senses.definition: the act or instance of travelling above the permitted speed
senses.definitionCN: 以超过允许速度行驶的行为或事例
senses.example: Officers were sent to stop overspeed at the bridge.
senses.exampleCN: 警员被派去大桥处制止超速行为。
senses.why: The verb is also used without an object, so the name of the act takes the same shape as a noun.
senses.whyCN: 这个动词常不带宾语地使用，行为本身就被同一个词形当作名词来指称。

senses.title: Describing a built-in safety device
senses.definition: used before a noun to describe a device that prevents or detects excessive speed
senses.definitionCN: 用在名词前，指防止或检测超速的装置
senses.example: An overspeed protection system shut down the turbine instantly.
senses.exampleCN: 超速保护系统立即关停了涡轮机。
senses.why: Technical English keeps the first element in place to name the thing being guarded against, as in alarm or protection compounds.
senses.whyCN: 技术英语把词干放在前位来命名被防范的对象，与 alarm、protection 等复合词的做法一致。

intro.en: Overspeed joins the Old English prefix ofer to the Latin loan speed, which reached English through Old French as a word for success and luck.
intro.cn: overspeed 由古英语前缀 ofer 与拉丁借词 speed 组成，而 speed 经古法语进入英语，原本表示「成功、好运」。

items.en: Ofer means over or above and begins compounds such as oferflowan.
items.cn: ofer 表示「在上方、超过」，并很早开始参与构词。

items.en: Behind the French forms stands the Latin verb spendere, to spend, from which words such as dispense also descend; scholars differ on how far this family explains English speed.
items.cn: 法语形式背后是拉丁动词 spendere（花费），dispense 等词也同出于此；这类词族能在多大程度上解释英语 speed，学界看法不一。

items.en: Old French esper and the verb despechier carry the word into England with the sense of success, quickness, or luck.
items.cn: 古法语 esper 与动词 despechier 把这类词形带入英格兰，当时带有「成功、迅速、好运」的意思。

items.en: Spe(e)d means prosperity or success, as in the phrase good speed.
items.cn: 中古英语 speed 意为「兴旺、成功」，如短语 good speed。

items.en: By the modern period speed means rate of motion, and compounds with over form technical terms from the eighteenth century onward.
items.cn: 到现代英语，speed 固定为「运动速率」，从十八世纪起，over 与 speed 的组合逐渐形成技术术语。

note.en: Overspeed pairs speed with the over- prefix, and it neighbours words about breaking speed limits and over- compounds used in engineering.
note.cn: overspeed 是 speed 加 over- 前缀构成的词，意义上与「超速、违反限速」一类词相邻，形式上还与工程领域的一批 over 复合词相邻。

entries.definition: the rate at which something moves
entries.definitionCN: 速度（overspeed 的基础词）

entries.definition: the offence of driving faster than the limit
entries.definitionCN: 超速驾驶（法律与交通语境更常用这个词）

entries.definition: to be too full and spill over
entries.definitionCN: 溢出；泛滥（与 overspeed 同为 over 加动词）

entries.definition: to put too much weight or work on something
entries.definitionCN: 使超载；负担过重

entries.definition: to go faster
entries.definitionCN: 加速（本身不含违规之意，只是加快）

entries.definition: to move or drive very quickly
entries.definitionCN: 疾驰；飞奔（强调快，而不一定超限）

entries.definition: to go beyond a set limit
entries.definitionCN: 超过（限度），如 exceed the speed limit

normalIntro.en: Overspeed is over plus speed: the reading on the dial has passed the number on the sign.
normalIntro.cn: overspeed 就是 over 加 speed：表盘上的读数越过了路牌上的数字。

normal.en: Over- carries the meaning beyond, so overspeed is to go beyond the permitted speed.
normal.cn: over- 表「超过」，所以 overspeed 就是超过允许的速度。

normal.en: In traffic law, speeding is the common noun, while overspeed appears mostly in signs and reports.
normal.cn: 交通法规里日常用 speeding 作名词，overspeed 多出现在标志与报告中。

normal.en: Overspeed protection is a classic engineering compound for a device that guards against excess speed.
normal.cn: overspeed protection 是典型的工程复合词，指防止超速的装置。

normal.en: Compare overload and overflow: all three share the over- prefix meaning beyond capacity.
normal.cn: 对比 overload 与 overflow：三者都有 over- 前缀，核心都是「超出承载或限度」。

normal.en: The past tense is usually oversped, though overspeeded also appears in older texts.
normal.cn: 过去式通常写 oversped，较早的文本里也能见到 overspeeded。

abstract.en: Picture the needle sweeping past the red mark while the driver keeps his foot down.
abstract.cn: 想象指针甩过红线，司机却仍不肯松脚。

abstract.en: Imagine a safety valve screaming just as the turbine spins too fast.
abstract.cn: 想象涡轮转得过快时，安全阀尖声报警。

abstract.en: Think of a speed sign overtaken so quickly that it becomes a blur.
abstract.cn: 想象限速牌被甩在身后，快得只剩一道模糊的影子。

examples.en: Cameras on the bridge catch drivers who overspeed at night.
examples.cn: 桥上的摄像头会拍下夜间超速的司机。

examples.en: Engineers installed an overspeed protection system on the new turbine.
examples.cn: 工程师为新涡轮机安装了超速保护系统。

examples.en: The machine must never overspeed, even for a second.
examples.cn: 这台机器绝不能超速运转，哪怕只有一瞬间。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「欧沃-斯屁德」——速度「吹」过了头，就是超速；这只是谐音联想，与词源无关。

root: over（超过，源自古英语 ofer）+ speed（速率，源自拉丁经古法语传入）→ 越过允许的速率，即「超速行驶」「超速运转」。

sensesIntro.en: Overspeed begins with a driver passing the speed limit, extends to machines running too fast, and then supplies names for the act and for protection devices.
sensesIntro.cn: overspeed 从「司机越过限速」开始，延伸到「机器转得过快」，再进一步用于命名这一行为与防护装置。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a needle that has swept past the marked limit.
core.cn: 核心意象：指针越过了标记的限度。

branches.en: A driver on the road is the first and most common subject.
branches.cn: 路上的司机是最先、也最常见的动作主体。

branches.en: A machine can also pass its designed speed.
branches.cn: 机器同样会越过设计转速。

branches.en: The act itself is named by the same form.
branches.cn: 同一词形也可以直接指称这一行为。

branches.en: Road limits need alarms, so the noun shades into attributive use.
branches.cn: 道路限速需要报警装置，于是这个词形转为定语用法。

branches.en: Engineering deals with overspeed by building protection devices.
branches.cn: 工程上对付超速的办法，就是造出保护装置。

intro.en: Overspeed combines the prefix over, meaning beyond, with the noun and verb speed.
intro.cn: overspeed 由表示「超过」的前缀 over 与名词兼动词 speed 组合而成。

latinIntro.en: The prefix is Germanic, but speed has a Latin history behind its Old French form, where it meant success and prosperity.
latinIntro.cn: 前缀属日耳曼语，而 speed 经古法语而来，背后有拉丁语源头，当时表示成功与兴旺。
