normalIntro.en: Panoramic is built from Greek pan, all, and horama, a sight, with the English adjective ending -ic.
normalIntro.cn: panoramic 由希腊语 pan（全部）、horama（所见之物）与英语形容词词尾 -ic 组成。

normal.en: Pan means all, so panoramic means the whole scene at once.
normal.cn: pan 意为「全部」，所以 panoramic 就是「全部景色一次入眼」。

normal.en: The noun panorama came before the adjective and keeps the same stem.
normal.cn: 名词 panorama 先出现，形容词沿用同一个词干。

normal.en: A panoramic view is the most common pairing in English.
normal.cn: panoramic view 是英语中最常见的搭配。

normal.en: Panoramic cameras stitch several frames into one wide image.
normal.cn: 全景相机把几帧画面拼成一张宽幅图像。

normal.en: Pan is also the word for a wide flat frying pan, a useful shape to hold in mind.
normal.cn: pan 也指宽而平的煎锅，这个形状可以顺手记在心里。

abstract.en: Stand on a cliff and turn slowly; the whole coastline slides past your eyes.
abstract.cn: 站在悬崖上慢慢转身，整条海岸线缓缓从眼前滑过。

abstract.en: A long painted scroll is unrolled across a wall and the whole city appears.
abstract.cn: 一幅长卷画在墙上一路展开，整座城市随之浮现。

abstract.en: Lift your eyes from one street to the whole map, and you are seeing panoramically.
abstract.cn: 把目光从一条街抬到整张地图，你就是在以全景方式观看。

examples.en: We reached the top just as the sun set over a panoramic plain.
examples.cn: 太阳落在平野上的时候，我们正好到达山顶。

examples.en: Her book is a panoramic account of trade in the ancient world.
examples.cn: 她的书对古代世界的贸易做了全景式的叙述。

examples.en: The studio was fitted with a panoramic window over the harbour.
examples.cn: 这间工作室装了一扇俯瞰海港的全景窗。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「盘着看」——绕一圈盘着看，四面八方尽收眼底；纯属谐音联想，与词源无关。

root: 希腊语 pan「全部」+ horan「看见」（名词 horama「所见之物」）→ 英语新造名词 panorama（1796 年前后）→ 形容词 panoramic，核心义「一眼尽收」。

sensesIntro.en: Panoramic starts with the eye taking in a whole landscape, extends to things spread across the view and to tools that capture them, and then widens into a way of understanding a subject.
sensesIntro.cn: panoramic 从「眼睛收下整片风景」出发，延伸到横贯视野的事物与捕捉它们的工具，最后扩展到理解一个主题的方式。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a person turns on a hilltop and the whole world fits in one glance.
core.cn: 核心意象：站在山顶的人回身一转，整个世界一同落进眼底。

branches.en: THE EYE: a wide, complete landscape seen from one point is the first sense.
branches.cn: 视线线：从一处看到的宽广完整的风景是第一个义项。

branches.en: THE MIND: the same whole-scene shape is applied to a subject or to overall understanding.
branches.cn: 思维线：同样的「全景」构形移到主题概览与总体理解上。

branches.en: THE SURFACE: something continuous that spreads across the visual field, like a forest belt or a coast road.
branches.cn: 表面线：像森林带或海岸公路那样横贯视野、绵延不断的事物。

branches.en: THE TOOL: cameras and screens that record or show the whole scene take the adjective as a label.
branches.cn: 工具线：记录或展示全场景的相机、屏幕以此词作标签。

branches.en: Both sense 01 and sense 04 come straight from the original painted panorama that surrounded the viewer.
branches.cn: 第 01 义与第 04 义都直接来自最初那种环绕观众的环形画。

intro.en: Panoramic is a Greek-derived compound with an English adjective ending; the noun panorama spawned a large family of -ama words.
intro.cn: panoramic 是希腊语来源的复合词，带英语形容词词尾；名词 panorama 又衍生出一大批 -ama 词。

latinIntro.en: The word is Greek, not Latin: pan and horama are both Greek. There are no Latin cognates, so the Latin entry list is left empty.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词来自希腊语而非拉丁语：pan 与 horama 都是希腊语，没有拉丁同源词，因此拉丁词条留空。

items.example: The prefix pan- opens the word and promises everything.
items.exampleCN: 前缀 pan- 开启全词，许下「全部」之意。

items.example: Pan is used alone too, as in pan-African.
items.exampleCN: pan 也可单独使用，如 pan-African（泛非洲的）。

items.example: The seeing verb supplies the eye of the word.
items.exampleCN: 这个表示「看见」的动词提供词中的「眼睛」。

items.meaning: that which is seen, a sight
items.example: Horama gives the noun its picture.
items.exampleCN: horama 为名词提供画面。

items.meaning: a wide view, a full picture
items.example: Panorama joined the two Greek elements into one English word.
items.exampleCN: panorama 把两个希腊语成分合成为一个英语词。

items.meaning: relating to, of the nature of
items.example: The suffix -ic turns panorama into an adjective.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -ic 把 panorama 变成形容词。

items.example: Panoramic describes the view, the tool, or the survey.
items.exampleCN: panoramic 可形容视野、工具或综述。

items.meaningCN: 整幅可见场景（仿造词尾）
items.example: The ending -ama spread to later coinages such as diorama.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -ama 扩散到 diorama 等后来的新造词。

items.meaning: a scene viewed through a small opening
items.example: Diorama copies the shape of panorama.
items.exampleCN: diorama 仿照 panorama 的构形。

definition_zh: 哑剧；童话哑剧；默演；比划
definition_en: a play that tells its story with gestures and actions instead of words, or the act of expressing something with gestures alone
core_image: 戴白面具的演员闭口不言，只靠身段与手势演完整个故事
scene: 剧院里的演员一声不吭，只靠身段与手势演完整个故事，台下掌声不断。The children watched a silent pantomime about a lost cat.
sceneCN: 这里 pantomime 是「哑剧」（第 1 个义项：以动作而非台词叙述的表演）；句意：孩子们观看了一出关于一只走失的猫的无声哑剧。

senses.title: Silent stage acting
senses.definition: a form of theatre in which actors perform without speech, telling a story through gesture and movement
senses.definitionCN: 一种演员不出声、仅以手势和动作叙述故事的戏剧形式
senses.example: The troupe performed a pantomime of a shipwreck.
senses.exampleCN: 剧团演了一出关于海难的哑剧。
senses.why: Greek pantos means all and mimos means an actor or imitation, so the word literally names an actor who imitates everything, and the silent stage sense grew from that.
senses.whyCN: 希腊语 pantos 意为「全部」，mimos 意为「演员、模仿」，字面即「模仿一切的演员」，沉默表演的舞台义由此长出。

senses.title: The British Christmas show
senses.definition: a British family show performed at Christmas, based on a fairy tale, with music, jokes and audience participation
senses.definitionCN: 英国圣诞节期间的家庭演出，取材童话，配上音乐、笑话与观众互动
senses.example: We took the children to a pantomime on Boxing Day.
senses.exampleCN: 节礼日那天我们带孩子们去看了一出圣诞童话剧。
senses.why: The Italian improvised stage without words travelled to England and turned into a festive show with songs and stock characters, yet kept the old name.
senses.whyCN: 这种无台词的意大利即兴舞台传到英国，变成有歌曲与固定角色的节庆演出，却沿用了旧名。

senses.title: Expressing something without words
senses.definition: the use of mime and gesture instead of speech to get a meaning across
senses.definitionCN: 不用说话，而用手势和比划传递意思
senses.example: She answered by pantomime, pointing to her watch.
senses.exampleCN: 她用手指指手表，做了一个示意动作来回答。
senses.why: Any silent mime, on stage or in a shop doorway, is described by the same word, because the word means an imitation made with the body.
senses.whyCN: 无论在舞台上还是在店门口，任何无声的示意动作都用同一个词，因为这个词本义就是「用身体做出来的模仿」。

senses.title: To act or express by mime
senses.titleCN: 以手势表演；比划着表达
senses.definition: to express something with gestures and bodily movement instead of words
senses.definitionCN: 用手势与身体动作而不说话来表达某事
senses.example: He pantomimed opening a door to show the way.
senses.exampleCN: 他比划着开门的动作，指明了方向。
senses.why: The noun became a verb, so the imitation passes from the stage into ordinary action.
senses.whyCN: 名词转为动词，于是这种「模仿」从舞台走进了日常动作。

senses.title: A showy or meaningless display
senses.definition: an event or behaviour treated as a pointless show or pretence
senses.definitionCN: 被当作无意义表演或装样子的场面与行为
senses.example: The inquiry was dismissed as a political pantomime.
senses.exampleCN: 那场调查被斥为一场政治表演。
senses.why: A show of gestures without words can also suggest words without substance, so the word extends to any empty performance.
senses.whyCN: 一场只有手势而没有台词的演出，也让人想到只有表演而没有实质，于是这个词扩展到任何空洞的场面。

intro.en: Pantomime joins Greek pantos, all, and mimos, an actor or a mime, first as the name of a Latin actor who imitated everything.
intro.cn: pantomime 由希腊语 pantos「全部」与 mimos「演员、摹拟」组合，最初指什么都能模仿的那种拉丁演员。

items.en: Pantos is an inflected form of pas, all, and mimos means an actor, a mime, or an imitation.
items.cn: pantos 是 pas「全部」的变格形式，mimos 指演员、摹拟演员或模仿。

items.en: Latin pantomimus names a dancer who performed every role without speaking, and mimi were the mimic entertainers of the Roman stage.
items.cn: 拉丁语 pantomimus 指不出声却演尽所有角色的舞蹈演员；mimi 则是罗马舞台上的摹拟艺人。

items.en: French pantomime was used for a silent musical drama before English took the word, so its first date in French is uncertain.
items.cn: 法语 pantomime 在英语借用之前已指无声音乐剧，其在法语中首次使用的年代不确定。

items.en: The English noun is recorded around 1600 for a mixed show of speaking and dancing, and the silent sense settled in the eighteenth century with visiting Italian troupes.
items.cn: 英语名词在十七世纪前列已指又说又跳的混合演出；以动作代言的「沉默」义，到十八世纪意大利剧团来访后才定型。

items.en: On the English stage the word came to name the Christmas entertainment with songs, stock characters and a shouting audience, a sense little used outside Britain.
items.cn: 在英语舞台上，这个词后来指带歌曲、固定角色与观众呼喊的圣诞演出，这一义在英国以外少用。

note.en: Pantomime stands in a family of Greek mime words and is easily confused with the shorter mime; near meanings point to silent performance and to empty show.
note.cn: pantomime 属于以希腊语 mimos 为根的一族词，容易与较短的 mime 混淆；近义方向一为无声表演，一为装样子。

normalIntro.en: Pantomime is Greek pan plus mimos: a mime who imitates everything, and who needs no voice to do it.
normalIntro.cn: pantomime 是希腊语 pan（全部）加 mimos（摹拟演员）：什么都模仿的演员，而且不用出声。

normal.en: Pan means all and mime means mime, so pantomime is a mime of everything.
normal.cn: pan 意为全部，mime 意为哑剧，所以 pantomime 就是「包罗万象的哑剧」。

normal.en: Mime alone is the everyday word; pantomime is the older and more theatrical relation.
normal.cn: 日常只说 mime，pantomime 则是更古老、更具戏剧性的同族词。

normal.en: A pantomime horse is played by two people under one costume, a vivid image of the word.
normal.cn: 哑剧马由两个人披一件道具服演成，是这个词最生动的注释。

normal.en: In Britain a Christmas pantomime is a family show, not a silent play.
normal.cn: 在英国，圣诞童话剧是家庭演出，并不是默剧。

normal.en: Pantomimic is the adjective and pantomimist the actor.
normal.cn: 形容词是 pantomimic，演员叫 pantomimist。

abstract.en: A white-faced performer spreads both arms as if holding the whole sky, and never says a word.
abstract.cn: 白面具演员张开双臂，仿佛托住整片天，却一言不发。

abstract.en: Imagine a glass wall in front of you, and you explain a whole day with your hands only.
abstract.cn: 想象面前有一堵玻璃墙，你只能用手讲完一整天的经历。

abstract.en: A stage full of painted trees and a hero in glitter, with the audience shouting the answer.
abstract.cn: 满是画出来的树与一身闪亮的英雄，台下观众一起喊出答案。

examples.en: The pantomime of a sailor rowing a boat made the children laugh.
examples.cn: 哑剧里划船的表演逗得孩子们大笑。

examples.en: They pantomimed their order to the waiter across the noisy room.
examples.cn: 在喧闹的餐厅里，他们用手势向服务员示意点单。

examples.en: Her firm put on a pantomime of consultation before deciding.
examples.cn: 她的公司先做了一场咨询表演，然后才作决定。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「盼着它慢」——演员盼着它慢速比划，一个字也不说；纯属谐音联想，与词源无关。

root: 希腊语 pantos「全部」（pas 的变格）+ mimos「演员、摹拟」→ 拉丁语 pantomimus「不说话的摹拟舞蹈演员」→ 法语 pantomime → 英语 pantomime，核心义「用身体模仿一切」。

sensesIntro.en: Pantomime begins with a silent stage style, became the British Christmas show, names any wordless gesture, takes a verb form, and finally labels an empty show.
sensesIntro.cn: pantomime 从沉默的舞台表演开始，演变为英国圣诞童话剧，泛指一切不用说话的手势，又生出动词用法，最后用来指一切空洞的场面。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a masked performer tells a whole story with the body alone and never opens the mouth.
core.cn: 核心意象：戴面具的演员闭口不言，只用身体演完整个故事。

branches.en: THE STAGE: a form of theatre in which the body replaces the voice.
branches.cn: 舞台线：以身体代替声音的戏剧形式。

branches.en: THE FESTIVAL: the Italian stage style became a British family show at Christmas.
branches.cn: 节庆线：意大利的舞台样式在英国变成圣诞家庭演出。

branches.en: THE ACT: the same imitation done outside a theatre, first as a noun and then as a verb.
branches.cn: 动作线：同样的模仿离开剧场，先作名词，再作动词。

branches.en: THE PRETENCE: a show without substance stands for words without substance.
branches.cn: 假象线：没有实质的表演，对应没有实质的表态。

branches.en: Stage mime and everyday gesture share one origin, an imitation made with the body instead of the voice.
branches.cn: 第 01 义与第 03 义同源，都是用身体而非声音做出的模仿。

intro.en: Pantomime is made of the Greek element pan plus mimos; English added the shorter mime and the adjective and noun suffixes around it.
intro.cn: pantomime 由希腊语成分 pan 加 mimos 构成；英语又衍生出较短的 mime，以及形容词、名词后缀。

latinIntro.en: The roots are Greek, and the word reached English through Latin pantomimus and French pantomime; the Latin forms are recorded and are listed below.
latinIntro.cn: 词根是希腊语，经拉丁语 pantomimus 与法语 pantomime 进入英语；拉丁语形式均有文献，列在下文。
